summary: OMR Exam UI Integration in Owner Portal - All features verified and working correctly. Tested exam type selector (Digital/OMR), OMR-specific fields, conditional buttons, AnswerKeyEditor bubble grid, and badge display in exam listing.

success_rate.backend: N/A - Backend testing skipped as requested
success_rate.frontend: 100% - All OMR UI features working correctly

seed_data_creation: Created test OMR exam 'Test OMR Exam - Automated Test' with 20 questions, 5 options (A-E), 1 point per question
context_for_next_testing_agent: OMR exam UI integration is complete and working. The test OMR exam created during testing can be used for further testing. Course used: Historia (ID: a1eb013c-1682-4411-b525-334a55f588d5)

exam_type_selector.details: Modal shows two options: 'Examen en linea' (Digital) and 'Examen fisico OMR'. Clicking toggles selection with visual feedback (green border for selected).

omr_specific_fields.details: When OMR type selected, shows: N. de preguntas (default 20), Opciones por pregunta (dropdown 5 A-E), Puntaje por pregunta (default 1), Total calculated (20 puntos = 20 preguntas x 1 pts)

omr_exam_creation.details: Successfully created OMR exam with title 'Test OMR Exam - Automated Test', 20 questions, 5 options, 1 point each

omr_badge_in_listing.details: OMR exams show green 'OMR' badge with grid icon next to title. Digital exams show blue 'Digital' badge with monitor icon.

conditional_buttons.details: OMR exams show 'CONFIGURAR CLAVE' button (green with key icon). Digital exams show 'GESTIONAR PREGUNTAS' button (purple with edit icon).

omr_info_display.details: OMR exams show 'X preguntas' and 'Y pts' in the right column instead of date/time shown for digital exams.

answer_key_editor.details: Clicking 'CONFIGURAR CLAVE' opens ExamDetailView with AnswerKeyEditor component. Shows: exam details (CURSO, TIPO: OMR, PREGUNTAS, TOTAL PUNTOS, ESTADO), progress bar (X de Y respuestas configuradas), bubble grid for all questions with options A-E, 'Limpiar todo' and 'Guardar clave' buttons.

bubble_selection.details: Clicking bubbles toggles selection. Selected bubbles show green filled state. Progress bar updates in real-time.

digital_exam_unchanged.details: Digital exams maintain original interface with date/time display and 'GESTIONAR PREGUNTAS' button.

10. Tested bubble selection - verified progress updates
11. Verified 'Limpiar todo' and 'Guardar clave' buttons present
